provenance.notes: Short mirror of G-GAP-TP-L-01: market reflected around the base price, signals and side flipped. Entry 99.98, stop 101.98, R 2, target 2 R = 95.98. Candle 282 opens at 94 (= its low, green: o->l->h->c, the first path point is the open). The take-profit is a market buy at the mark: 94 x 1.0002 = 94.0188; pnl = 5 x (99.98 - 94.0188) - 5 x (99.98 + 94.0188) x 0.0005 = 29.321003. The legacy backtest books the level 95.98 x 1.0002 (the mirrored long TP-gap divergence).
